text:
Roaming charge on a plan sold as inclusive
Account 4471-8820, consumer mobile, monthly plan advertised as including roaming in 30 listed countries. The September bill carries a roaming data charge of 62.40. The agent can see the country the usage was billed under, can waive up to 75.00 per account per year, and cannot edit the plan terms.
My September bill has a roaming data charge of sixty-two forty on account 4471-8820. I was told this plan includes roaming in thirty countries.
I was in a country your own list names, and I have boarding passes for both directions. I never left it during the billing period.
I need to know today whether that sixty-two forty is coming off. If it is not, tell me plainly before the payment date.

Autopay debited twice in one cycle
Account 7702-3391. The system shows two successful direct-debit collections of 48.00 on the same date. The agent can confirm both collections, can request a refund that takes five to seven banking days, and cannot reverse a debit instantly.
Two payments of forty-eight went out of my bank on the same day for account 7702-3391. My bill is forty-eight, not ninety-six.
A credit on next month's bill does not help me. The second debit put my current account overdrawn and the bank has charged me for that.
Can you send the forty-eight back to the account it came from, and on what date will it land? I need a date for my bank.

Promotional discount ended without notice
Account 1188-6504. A 12-month promotional discount of 15.00 per month expired in August; the bill rose from 34.00 to 49.00. Notice of the end date appears in the original order confirmation. The agent can offer a current retention promotion of 10.00 per month for six months and cannot reinstate an expired promotion.
My bill on account 1188-6504 jumped from thirty-four to forty-nine this month with no warning I ever saw. Nobody wrote to me and nobody called.
I have searched every email from you since last year and found no reminder. A line in an order confirmation a year ago is not notice anyone would find.
I want to know whether you will put the price back to thirty-four, or whether forty-nine is final. I need that before I decide anything.

Device protection add-on never ordered
Account 9053-2217. A device protection add-on at 7.99 per month has billed for four months. The order log shows the add-on was attached during an in-store upgrade. The agent can remove the add-on immediately and refund up to three months of an unused add-on.
There is a device protection charge of seven ninety-nine on account 9053-2217 that I never asked for. It has been billing for four months.
The only time I entered a store was the upgrade in May, and nobody mentioned insurance. I have never made a claim on it either.
Please take it off and tell me how much of the four months you are refunding. Say so now rather than leaving it to the next bill.

Proration after a mid-cycle plan change
Account 6614-7728. The customer moved from a 25.00 plan to a 40.00 plan on the 18th of the cycle. The bill shows 25.00, a credit of 9.68, and 40.00, totalling 55.32. The agent can explain proration, can issue goodwill up to 15.00, and cannot alter billing dates.
My bill on 6614-7728 is fifty-five thirty-two and I changed to a forty-pound plan. Three separate lines appear and none matches what I expected.
I accept that I owe something for the part-month, but I was told on the call that the change would take effect next month with no overlap.
Either the fifty-five thirty-two is correct and you explain it so I can check it, or it is not and you adjust it. Which is it?

Late fee after an on-time payment
Account 3390-1145. A late fee of 12.00 was applied on the 6th. The payment record shows funds received on the 5th, one day inside the due date, but posted on the 7th. The agent can remove an incorrectly applied fee without approval.
Account 3390-1145 has a twelve-pound late fee on it. I paid on the fifth, before the due date, and I have the bank reference in front of me.
Your system posted it on the seventh, but that is your processing time, not my delay. The money left my account on the fifth and the bank confirms it.
I want the twelve pounds removed and I want to know it will not recur next month. Can you confirm both of those, or only one?

Broadband installation appointment missed
Order BB-55120, broadband installation booked for a morning window on the 12th. The engineer log shows no visit and no attempt record. The agent can rebook the next available slot, which is nine days out, and can issue a missed-appointment payment of 30.00.
I took a morning off work for a broadband installation on the twelfth under order BB-55120. Nobody came, nobody rang, and no card was left.
I called once already and was told an engineer would come that afternoon. I waited until six and nothing happened, so that is two days lost.
Give me a firm installation date and tell me what compensation applies for both days. If the next date is weeks away, say so now.

Replacement SIM not delivered
Order SIM-88210, replacement SIM dispatched eleven days ago by untracked post. The service standard is three working days. The agent can resend by tracked courier for next-day delivery and can activate an eSIM immediately on a compatible handset.
I ordered a replacement SIM eleven days ago, order SIM-88210, and it has not arrived. My old one stopped working, so I have had no service.
I have checked with neighbours and the sorting office and nothing is held there. I am also caring for my father, so being without a phone is difficult.
Can you get me working today by any route you have? If not, give me the earliest realistic date so I can borrow a phone.

Number porting stuck in progress
Port request PAC-40771, submitted nine days ago. The standard transfer is one working day. The status shows rejected by the losing provider for a name mismatch. The agent can resubmit with corrected details and cannot complete the port unilaterally.
I asked to move my number to you nine days ago with code PAC-40771. Your app still says in progress and my old provider says it is finished with.
Nobody has told me anything was wrong. If a name did not match, you had that detail from my application on day one and could have asked.
Tell me what is actually needed from me and when the number will move. I have customers ringing the old line and need a reliable date.

Refund for a returned router not credited
Return RTN-30948. The router was received back at the warehouse twenty-three days ago. The refund of 89.00 was approved but not released. The agent can push the refund for release within two working days and can credit the account instantly instead.
I returned a router under RTN-30948 and your warehouse signed for it twenty-three days ago. The eighty-nine pounds has never come back to me.
I was told fourteen days when I sent it. That window closed over a week ago, and the app simply shows the return as complete with nothing attached.
I need the eighty-nine pounds released to my card with a date, or a straight answer that it is not coming back that way. Which is it?

Fibre upgrade stalled at pending survey
Order FIB-20553, placed five weeks ago, status pending survey. Survey bookings in this postcode are quoted at six weeks. The agent can flag the order for survey prioritisation, can offer a 10.00 monthly credit while the upgrade is outstanding, and cannot guarantee a survey date.
My fibre upgrade, order FIB-20553, has said pending survey for five weeks. Nothing has changed and nobody has contacted me to arrange anything.
I am already paying the higher fibre price, which started the month I ordered. So I am paying for a service that has not been installed.
I want either a survey date or the billing put back to what I paid before. Tell me which one you can actually do today.

Technician visit rescheduled three times
Fault ticket FLT-77123. Three engineer appointments have been booked and cancelled by the network side over four weeks. The agent can book a guaranteed slot with a supervisor hold and can issue 25.00 per missed appointment.
Ticket FLT-77123 has had three engineer appointments and you cancelled every one of them. The fault it was raised for has been live four weeks.
Each time I was told the next slot was guaranteed. I rearranged work for all three and the last cancellation arrived by text forty minutes beforehand.
I am not booking a fourth appointment on the same terms. Tell me what you can guarantee now and what you are paying for the three failures.

Broadband drops every evening
Line 0208-441-2290. Line diagnostics show repeated resyncs between 19:00 and 23:00 over fourteen days, consistent with an external line fault. The agent can book an engineer, can apply a fault credit, and cannot fix the line remotely.
My broadband on 0208-441-2290 disconnects several times every evening, always between about seven and eleven. During the day it is perfectly stable.
I have already replaced the cables, moved the router and done a factory reset on your instructions. The pattern has not changed at all since then.
I would like an engineer booked and a date. If you want more remote tests first, tell me how long that takes before anyone comes.

Data works but calls fail
Mobile number 0771-336-4408. Data sessions register normally; voice registration fails on the home network and succeeds when roaming. This pattern matches a provisioning record error. The agent can reprovision the line, which takes up to two hours, and can issue a temporary divert.
Calls from my mobile 0771-336-4408 fail instantly with a network error. Data is completely fine, so messaging apps and email work without any problem.
It started the day my new contract began. It also works normally abroad, which makes me think something is wrong at your end rather than my handset.
Please fix the calling or give me some way to receive calls today. I have a hospital appointment on Thursday and they will ring this number.

Wi-Fi speed far below the plan
Account 5527-9034 on a 500 Mbps fibre plan. Router statistics show 480 Mbps at the port and 40 Mbps over Wi-Fi in the customer's room. The agent can send a mesh extender free of charge and can book an in-home visit chargeable at 65.00.
I pay for five hundred megabits on account 5527-9034 and get about forty in the room where I work. By the router it measures full speed.
The house is stone-built and the router sits at the opposite end from my desk, which I cannot move. I have already changed the wireless channel.
What can you give me to fix this, and does it cost anything? I need the number before I agree to anything being sent or booked.

Voicemail not delivering messages
Mobile number 0790-882-1176. Voicemail deposits are recorded on the platform but delivery notifications are not sent; the mailbox greeting plays normally. The agent can reset the mailbox, which erases stored messages, and can retrieve existing messages before the reset.
People tell me they leave voicemails on 0790-882-1176 and I never get a notification. When I dial the mailbox it says I have no new messages.
I run a small business from this number, so I have probably lost enquiries this fortnight. Two customers have told me directly that they left messages.
Can you recover anything sitting on the system and then fix the notifications? Tell me if fixing it means losing whatever is stored there.

No 5G on a 5G plan
Account 2244-8891, plan includes 5G. The handset is 5G capable, the SIM profile is 4G-only, and the customer's postcode has confirmed 5G coverage. The agent can update the SIM profile, which requires a handset restart, and cannot change coverage.
I upgraded to a plan with five-G on account 2244-8891 and my phone has never shown it. It sits on four-G even where your map shows coverage.
The handset is a five-G model bought from you in the same order, and a colleague on another network gets five-G standing next to me.
Is this something you can switch on from your side today, or is my area simply not live? A straight answer either way is fine.

Noise on the landline after a storm
Landline 0161-224-7781. Line tests show high resistance consistent with water ingress in external cabling after storm damage; the area has an open mass-outage record. The agent can attach the line to the mass fault and cannot book an individual engineer while it is open.
My landline 0161-224-7781 has loud crackling on every call since the storm last week. I can barely hear the other person and they say the same.
My neighbour on the same street has the identical problem and was told an engineer would come. This is our only line and my mother calls daily.
So do I get my own engineer, or am I waiting for the area repair? Please tell me which, and roughly when it will be fixed.

Cancelling broadband before moving abroad
Account 8813-0092, broadband contract with seven months remaining and an early termination charge of 133.00. The agent can waive the charge where the customer is moving outside the service footprint on receipt of evidence and can set a future disconnection date.
I need to cancel the broadband on account 8813-0092 because I am moving abroad next month. I am not moving locally, so a transfer is impossible.
I understand seven months remain on the contract. I did not choose to break it early and would have kept it had the job not been relocated.
Tell me whether the early termination charge applies in my situation and what you need from me. I want this settled before I start packing.

Returning a handset inside the cooling-off window
Order HS-66201, handset delivered eleven days ago. The cooling-off window is fourteen days from delivery. The device has been used and the box seal is broken. The agent can issue a returns label and a full refund if the device is undamaged.
I want to return the handset from order HS-66201. It arrived eleven days ago and it is simply too large to use comfortably with one hand.
I have been using it, so the box is open and a screen protector is fitted. There is no damage, but it is not in its sealed state.
Can I still return it and get everything back, or does the opened box change the amount? Please tell me the figure before I send it.

Cancelling a television add-on package
Account 4408-7752 with a 22.00 monthly television add-on inside a 12-month minimum term, five months elapsed. The agent can cancel with an exit charge of 40.00, can downgrade to a 9.00 tier with no charge, and cannot cancel free of charge.
I would like to cancel the television package on account 4408-7752. We barely use it since the children went back to school and it costs twenty-two monthly.
I was not aware it carried its own twelve-month term when I added it by phone. I thought it was a month-to-month extra alongside the broadband.
What is the cheapest way out of it for me? Give me the options with the actual costs and I will pick one now.

Terminating early because of no coverage at a new address
Account 9921-3340, mobile contract with nine months remaining. Coverage at the new address is recorded as poor indoors. Policy allows termination without charge if a coverage complaint has been open for thirty days without resolution; the complaint is fourteen days old.
I moved house six weeks ago and my mobile on account 9921-3340 has no usable signal indoors. I have to stand in the garden to hold a call.
I raised this fourteen days ago and was sent a signal booster that made no difference. Nine months remain on the contract and I cannot use it.
I want to leave without paying those nine months. Tell me whether that is possible now, or what has to happen first before it is.

Final bill paid twice after closure
Closed account 1163-5528. The final bill of 27.40 was paid by card, and the cancelled direct debit collected the same amount four days later. The agent can refund to either payment method, card refunds taking three days and bank transfers taking five.
I closed account 1163-5528 last month and paid the final bill of twenty-seven forty by card. Four days later the same amount went by direct debit.
The account is closed, so a credit has nothing to sit against. I am not a customer any more and no further bills are coming.
Please send the twenty-seven forty back. Tell me which method is quicker and how many days it takes, and then use that one.

Cancelling a second line on a family account
Account 3376-2218 with three lines. Line two ends its term in two months; cancelling now carries a 24.00 charge. The customer is the named account holder. The agent can cancel any line, can schedule a cancellation for the term end date, and cannot remove the charge if cancelled early.
I want to cancel the second line on account 3376-2218. My son has his own contract now and that line has had no usage for three months.
I would rather not pay anything to close it. If waiting is cheaper I will wait, but I do not want it rolling on quietly for another year.
So what does it cost to stop it now, and what happens if I leave it until the term ends? Then I will tell you which.

Locked out of the self-service portal
Account 7248-1130. The online profile is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. The agent can trigger a password reset to the registered email, can unlock after identity verification, and cannot read or set the password.
I cannot get into my online account for 7248-1130. It says my profile is locked, and the reset link it sends me does nothing when clicked.
The registered email is one I still use and the reset messages do arrive. The link opens a page saying the token is invalid, on two browsers.
I need access today to download a bill for my accountant. Either fix the reset or send me the bill another way, whichever is faster.

Account still in a former housemate's name
Account 5590-4417 registered to a previous occupant who has moved out. The current occupant pays the bill from their own bank account. A change of account holder requires the named holder's consent or proof of tenancy plus twelve months of payment history.
The broadband at my address, account 5590-4417, is still in my old housemate's name. She moved out a year ago and I have paid every bill.
She has moved abroad and I cannot reliably reach her, so getting her to call you is unrealistic. I do have my tenancy agreement and bank statements.
Can you put the account in my name using what I have, or is her consent the only route? Tell me which, and what to send.

Security code going to an old number
Account 6032-7714. Two-factor codes are sent to a mobile number the customer no longer controls. Changing the security number normally requires a code sent to that number. The agent can verify by account history questions and update the number after verification.
Every time I sign in to account 6032-7714 you send a code to a mobile number I gave up two years ago. I cannot access that number.
To change the security number your website wants a code sent to that same old number, which I cannot receive. It is a loop I cannot escape.
Please change the number on the account to my current mobile. Tell me what you need to prove who I am and let us do it.

Changing the name on the account after marriage
Account 2287-9041. The customer has changed their surname and asks for the account, bills and direct debit to be updated. Policy requires sight of a marriage certificate or deed poll. The agent can accept a scanned document and can update the name within one billing cycle.
I changed my surname after getting married and account 2287-9041 still shows the old one. My bank details are already updated under the new name.
The mismatch is causing problems, because the direct debit reference no longer matches my bank records and my last payment was queried by them.
What document do you need and how do I send it? I would like the bills to show the new name from the next cycle.

Plan downgrade blocked in the app
Account 4471-9982 on a 45.00 plan. The app blocks downgrades because a device instalment plan is attached, requiring a minimum airtime tier of 30.00. The requested 20.00 plan is below that floor. The agent can move the customer to a 30.00 plan today.
Your app will not let me move to the twenty-pound plan on account 4471-9982. It shows the plan, lets me select it, then fails with an error.
I bought my phone through you on instalments, which I pay separately each month. That is the only thing I can think of that makes my account different.
Is the twenty-pound plan available to me or not? If not, tell me the lowest one I can have and put me on it.

Adding an authorised user to manage the account
Account 8804-1267. The named holder wants a relative to be able to discuss and change the account. Policy permits a nominated user with the holder's verbal authorisation on the line, limited to service changes and excluding contract cancellation.
I want my daughter to be able to deal with account 8804-1267 for me. I am in hospital a while and cannot always take calls or reach a computer.
She lives at a different address and is not on the bill, so I expect you need something from me. I am the account holder and I am here.
Can we set that up in this conversation, and what will she be allowed to do afterwards? I need to know before I hand anything over.

Charged at full price after a voucher was applied
Order R-482013. A 20 percent voucher was accepted at checkout but the captured amount is the full 96.00. The order record shows the voucher recorded and not deducted. The agent can refund the 19.20 difference to the original card and cannot reissue an expired voucher.
Order R-482013 was charged at ninety-six pounds even though the twenty percent voucher went through at checkout. The confirmation screen showed the reduced total before I paid.
I still have the confirmation email listing the voucher code, but the amount at the bottom is the full price. Your own email contradicts itself.
I want the nineteen twenty difference back on my card. Can you do that today, and how long before it shows on my statement?

Delivery charge on an order above the free threshold
Order R-490771, basket value 58.00 against a free delivery threshold of 50.00. A 4.95 delivery charge was applied because one item ships from a partner warehouse. The exclusion is stated on the product page. The agent can refund the charge as goodwill once per customer.
I was charged four ninety-five delivery on order R-490771 even though the basket came to fifty-eight pounds. Your banner says delivery is free over fifty.
I have ordered from you several times and never paid delivery on a basket this size. Nothing at checkout warned me that this order would be treated differently.
Refund the four ninety-five or tell me clearly why it stands. If there is an exception I should have seen, show me where it was.

Pending authorisation held after a cancelled order
Order R-501228 was cancelled by the warehouse before dispatch. The 214.00 authorisation is still held on the customer's card. Authorisations release in five to ten days depending on the issuing bank; the agent cannot release them directly.
You cancelled order R-501228 yourselves because the item was out of stock, but two hundred and fourteen pounds is still showing as pending on my card six days later.
Your email said no payment had been taken. My bank shows the money as unavailable to me, so whatever it is called, I cannot spend it.
Tell me exactly when that hold disappears and what you can do to speed it up. I need the money before the weekend.

Billed for an item that was never in the parcel
Order R-512900 of four items, invoiced at 143.00. The parcel weight recorded at dispatch is consistent with three items. The agent can refund the missing item at 31.00 or resend it, and can open a warehouse investigation.
Order R-512900 was billed for four items but only three arrived. The invoice in the box lists all four, and the packaging was sealed and undamaged when it reached me.
The missing one is the thirty-one pound lamp, which is the largest of the four. There is clearly not room in that box for it, so it was never packed.
I would rather have the lamp than the money, but I need to know today which you are giving me and when it arrives.

Price dropped the day after purchase
Order R-523114, placed on the 3rd at 180.00; the same item listed at 144.00 on the 4th. The published price-promise window is fourteen days and covers price reductions on the retailer's own site. The agent can refund the 36.00 difference.
I bought a coat on order R-523114 for a hundred and eighty pounds, and the next day your site had it at a hundred and forty-four.
I looked for your price promise and the page mentions matching other retailers, but it is not obvious whether your own reductions count for something already ordered.
Can you refund the thirty-six pound difference, or do I have to return it and buy it again? Tell me which is quicker.

Subscription box charged after a skip request
Subscription S-77401. The customer requested a skip for October through the app; the log shows the request submitted eleven hours after the cut-off. The 39.00 box has shipped. The agent can refund on return, can waive return postage, and cannot recall a shipped box.
I asked to skip October on subscription S-77401 and you charged and shipped it anyway. Thirty-nine pounds went out on the same day I made the request in the app.
The app did not warn me that I had missed a cut-off. It accepted the skip and showed October as skipped on the schedule screen afterwards.
I do not want the box. Tell me whether I get the thirty-nine pounds back and whether I am paying to send it to you.

Parcel marked delivered but not received
Order R-530918. The courier records delivery to a safe place on the 9th with a photograph of a doorway that is not the customer's. The agent can issue a replacement immediately or refund, and must record a non-delivery claim with the courier.
Order R-530918 says delivered on the ninth but nothing arrived. The photograph on the tracking page shows a blue front door and mine is white with a glass panel.
I have asked both neighbours and checked with the building's post room. Nobody has it, and no card was left anywhere on the property.
Please either send it again or refund me. I need it by Friday, so if a replacement cannot arrive by then, refund instead.

Order stuck at preparing for dispatch
Order R-541220, placed nine days ago, status preparing for dispatch. Stock shows zero for one of the three items. The agent can split the order and ship the available items today, can cancel the unavailable item, and cannot give a restock date.
My order R-541220 has said preparing for dispatch for nine days. Nothing has moved on the tracking page and I have had no emails since the confirmation.
There are three items in it and two of them are for a birthday on Saturday. The third is not urgent and I would happily wait for that one separately.
Can you send what you have now and deal with the rest later? If not, tell me and I will cancel the whole thing.

Refund not received after a returned parcel
Return RET-22890, received back at the warehouse fifteen days ago. The published refund window is ten working days from receipt. The refund of 74.50 is queued but not processed. The agent can expedite it to two working days.
I returned a parcel under RET-22890 and your warehouse scanned it in fifteen days ago. The seventy-four fifty has not come back.
Your policy says ten working days from receipt, which has now passed. The tracking clearly shows it was signed for, so there is no question about whether you have it.
Give me a date for the refund. If you cannot give me one, say so and I will take it up with my card provider instead.

Click-and-collect order not ready at the store
Order R-552017 for collection at the Riverside store, marked ready to collect. Store stock shows the item allocated but not located. The agent can reallocate to another store six miles away for same-day collection or convert to home delivery for the next day.
I drove to the Riverside store for click-and-collect order R-552017 after your ready-to-collect email. The desk spent twenty minutes looking and could not find it anywhere.
They told me to contact you rather than waiting. I do not have a car tomorrow, so going back to that store is not something I can easily do.
What are my options that do not involve me returning to Riverside? Give me them with times and costs, and I will choose now.

Furniture delivery window missed twice
Order R-560442, a sofa with a two-man delivery. Two booked windows passed with no delivery and no contact. The next available slot is eighteen days out. The agent can offer a 50.00 goodwill credit and can request a priority slot with no guarantee.
My sofa on order R-560442 has had two delivery windows and neither happened. Both times I waited the whole day and nobody arrived or called to explain.
I have no seating in the living room because I disposed of the old sofa before the first date. That is now nearly three weeks of an empty room.
I need a date that will actually hold, and I want to know what you are doing about the two that did not.

Pre-order release date passed with no update
Pre-order R-571339 for an item whose release date passed eight days ago. The supplier has moved the release by three weeks and no customer notification was sent. The agent can cancel with a full refund, can hold the pre-order, and cannot advance the supplier date.
I pre-ordered an item on R-571339 for release on the second. That date passed over a week ago and I have heard absolutely nothing from you since.
The money was taken at the time of the pre-order, so you have had a hundred and twenty pounds of mine for two months with nothing to show for it.
Tell me the real release date and whether I can cancel and get the money back now. I want both answers before I decide.

Checkout fails at the payment step
Customer account A-88102. Checkout fails with a generic error at the payment step on card and wallet. Logs show the failures come from an address-verification mismatch with the saved billing address. The agent can clear the saved address and can place the order manually.
Your checkout fails every time I try to pay on account A-88102. It thinks for a moment and then shows an error that just says something went wrong.
I have tried two different cards and a digital wallet, on both my laptop and my phone. My bank confirms no attempt has even reached them, so it is failing before that.
Can you place the order for me, or fix whatever is wrong on the account? The sale ends tonight, so timing matters here.

Appliance failed within the warranty period
Order R-580226, a kettle delivered four months ago with a two-year warranty. The fault described matches a known batch defect under a manufacturer advisory. The agent can arrange a direct replacement without inspection under that advisory.
The kettle from order R-580226 has stopped heating. It was delivered four months ago and it powers on, lights up, and then simply never boils the water.
I have tried it on two different sockets and descaled it as the manual says. Nothing changed, and there is a faint burning smell when it runs now.
I would like a replacement rather than a repair. Can you do that, and do I need to send the old one back first?

Loyalty points not credited for recent orders
Account A-90337. Three orders in the last two months show no loyalty points. The account was migrated to a new loyalty scheme in August and points accrual was not re-linked. The agent can credit missing points manually after checking order values.
My loyalty points have not moved on account A-90337 despite three orders in the last two months. The balance is exactly what it was at the end of July.
I did get an email in August about the scheme changing, and I clicked through and accepted the new terms at the time. Everything else on my account looks normal.
Please add the points I should have earned and confirm the new balance. I want to use them on an order this week.

Wrong size shipped against the size guide
Order R-591804 for a jacket in size medium. The delivered garment is labelled medium but measures to the size guide's small. A supplier sizing error is recorded for this batch. The agent can exchange for a large at the medium price and can refund with free return.
The jacket on order R-591804 is labelled medium but it fits like a small. I measured it against your own size guide and the chest is four centimetres under.
I usually take a medium in your clothing and have three other items from you that fit properly. So this is not me having ordered the wrong size.
I want one that actually fits. Is a large going to be right given the mislabelling, and will I pay the difference?

Digital gift card code not working
Gift card GC-44821 for 50.00, purchased eleven days ago. The code is valid but was partially redeemed for 12.00 against an order the recipient does not recognise. The agent can void the balance and reissue a new code for the remaining 38.00 and can investigate the redemption.
The gift card code GC-44821 my sister sent me will not work at checkout. It was for fifty pounds and your site says the balance is not enough for my order.
My order is only forty-five pounds, so fifty should easily cover it. I have never used this code before and it arrived by email eleven days ago.
Can you tell me what happened to the missing money and give me a working code for what is left? I would like both today.

Order confirmation emails not arriving
Account A-91550. Confirmation and dispatch emails are not delivered; the mail log shows hard bounces from the customer's domain. The registered address contains a typographic error. The agent can correct the address and resend the last three confirmations.
I do not receive any emails from you on account A-91550. No order confirmations, no dispatch notices, nothing, although the orders themselves go through fine.
I have checked the spam folder every time and added your address to my contacts. My other online accounts email me at the same address without any trouble.
Please find out why and resend my recent confirmations. I need the last one for an expenses claim that is due on Monday.

Cancelling an order that has already been picked
Order R-600471, placed two hours ago, already picked and awaiting courier collection. Cancellation is not possible once picked. The agent can flag for a refuse-on-delivery return or issue a prepaid return label, both refunding in full on receipt.
I placed order R-600471 two hours ago and I need to cancel it. I ordered the wrong model and the right one is a different product entirely.

Refund for a gift bought by someone else

Two accounts created against one email

Business account applied to the wrong orders

Marketing preferences ignored after opting out

Requesting deletion of a shopping account

Overdraft interest after a promised buffer

Foreign transaction fees on a fee-free account

Direct debit collected after cancellation

Duplicate card payment at a retailer

Monthly account fee on an account sold as free
Account ending 3308. A 9.95 monthly account fee has been charged for seven months. The account was opened on a free tier and auto-migrated to a packaged tier during a product change, with notice sent by post. The agent can refund up to three months and can switch back to a free tier.

Transfer not arrived at the recipient bank

Replacement debit card not delivered

Account opening stuck in verification

Cheque deposit not cleared

Standing order missed on the due date
Standing order SO-22104 for 380.00 monthly rent, due on the 1st, not executed because the 1st fell on a bank holiday and the instruction is set to non-working-day skip. The agent can send the payment today and can change the rule to next working day.

Send it now if you can, and change whatever setting caused this. I also want something in writing explaining it for my landlord.

Business account signatory change

Blocked from registering a new device

My old phone is gone, so I cannot receive that code at all. The number on my account clearly never got updated when I switched.
Change the number to my current one and get me into the app. What do you need from me to prove who I am?

Address change rejected by verification

Tell me which document you will accept and how to send it. I want my statements going to the right place from now on.

Seat selection charged twice on one booking

Resort fee not shown at booking

Baggage charged at the gate despite an included allowance

Currency conversion applied against the customer's choice

Change fee charged on a flexible fare

Car hire deposit not released

My car hire booking CH-40027 finished eighteen days ago and the two hundred and fifty pound deposit is still held on my card.

Refund for a cancelled flight not received

My flight on booking LD8801 was cancelled by you thirty-one days ago and the four hundred and twelve pound refund has still not arrived.

Hotel confirmation never issued

Account UT-7719, gas. Following a tariff change on the 15th, the bill applies two standing charges of 0.31 per day for the overlapping period, adding about 4.65. The agent can correct the overlap and reissue the bill.
My gas bill on account UT-7719 has two standing charges running at the same time for part of the month. It adds a few pounds on top.
I changed tariff on the fifteenth, and it looks like both the old and new standing charges are being applied across that period.
Correct it and send me a clean bill. It is a small amount, but I want the document to be right on my record.

Back-billed for eighteen months
Account UT-5528, electricity. A catch-up bill of 960.00 covers eighteen months of under-billing caused by a supplier meter-data error. Back-billing rules limit recovery to twelve months where the supplier is at fault. The agent can reduce the bill accordingly and set a payment plan.
I have received a catch-up bill for nine hundred and sixty pounds on account UT-5528, covering eighteen months of under-billing I knew nothing about.
I paid every bill you sent me on time, in full. This is the first I have heard that the amounts were wrong at your end.
Recalculate what you can actually charge me and set up a payment plan for the rest. I cannot pay this in one go.

Charged for a previous occupant's usage
Account UT-9014, water. The opening bill includes 260.00 of usage predating the customer's move-in date of 1 August, evidenced by a tenancy agreement. The agent can move the pre-occupancy usage to the void account.
My first water bill on account UT-9014 includes two hundred and sixty pounds of usage from before I moved in. I arrived on the first of August.
I have a tenancy agreement showing the start date, and I took a meter photo on the day I got the keys.
Take the earlier usage off my account completely. Tell me exactly what I am left owing once that has all been done.

Direct debit raised without notice
Account UT-2260. The monthly direct debit rose from 96.00 to 174.00 on the 1st. The annual review notice was sent to the online account only, which the customer has never accessed. The balance justifies an increase to about 128.00. The agent can reset the amount.
My direct debit on account UT-2260 went from ninety-six pounds to a hundred and seventy-four this month. Nobody told me it was changing.
My usage has not changed at all. I have never logged into the online account, so any notice left there would not have reached me.
Set it to a realistic figure and refund the difference for this month. Tell me what figure you are setting before we finish.

Late payment fee after a payment date change
Account UT-6673. A 12.00 late fee was applied after the customer moved the payment date from the 1st to the 20th; the change did not take effect for one cycle. The change request is recorded. The agent can waive the fee.
I have been charged a twelve pound late fee on account UT-6673, but I moved my payment date to the twentieth with your agreement.
I made that change last month because my wages arrive on the eighteenth. The payment did leave my account on the twentieth as arranged.
Waive the fee and make sure the new date is properly in place. I do not want this happening every month from now on.

Smart meter installation repeatedly postponed
Account UT-4417. Three installation appointments have been cancelled by the supplier, the latest on the morning of the visit. Next availability is in five weeks. The agent can book a priority slot and can apply a missed-appointment payment of 30.00 per occurrence.
My smart meter installation on account UT-4417 has been cancelled three times now. The last one was cancelled on the morning of the visit itself.
I took a day of unpaid leave for that appointment. Nobody called me; I found out from a text message two hours before the slot.
Book me something firm this time and tell me what compensation applies. I want both of those settled on this call today.

Supplier switch stuck in progress
Account UT-8802. A switch away to another supplier has been in progress for six weeks; the standard window is five working days. The switch is blocked by an unresolved address mismatch in the industry record. The agent can raise a data correction.
My switch to another supplier on account UT-8802 has been in progress for six weeks. I am told it normally takes five working days.
The new supplier says they are waiting on your side. I am still being billed by you at a rate I never agreed to continue.
Tell me what is blocking it and fix it. If it is an address record, correct it today and confirm to the other supplier.

Refund of a closed-account credit not received
Closed account UT-1129 with a credit balance of 212.00, refund requested seven weeks ago against a stated ten working days. The refund failed because the final bill was not issued, which blocks the payout. The agent can issue the final bill and release the refund.
I closed account UT-1129 and asked for my two hundred and twelve pound credit back seven weeks ago. Nothing has arrived at all.
I moved out in July and gave a closing reading on the day. I have had no final bill from you either, now that I think about it.
Issue whatever is outstanding and pay me the credit back. Give me a date for it that I can hold you to.

Reported water leak not attended
Job WL-33028, a reported leak at the boundary stop tap, logged nine days ago. The published attendance target for a non-emergency external leak is five working days. The job is unassigned. The agent can assign it and can arrange an emergency visit if the leak worsens.
I reported a leak nine days ago under job WL-33028 and nobody has been out. Water is still running across the pavement outside my house.
It is at the stop tap by the boundary, so I understand it is your side rather than mine. It has got noticeably worse this week.
Get someone out to it this week. Tell me when, and what I should do if it floods the road before then.

New connection energisation overdue
Job NC-77021, a new-build electricity connection. Energisation was due four weeks ago; the work is complete but awaiting a meter appointment that was never booked. The agent can book the meter appointment within five working days.
Our new connection under job NC-77021 was due to be energised four weeks ago. The cable work was all finished well before that date.
We cannot complete the building sign-off without power, and the site has been standing idle at cost to us since the original date.
Book whatever is outstanding and give me a firm date. I need something I can pass to the site manager in writing today.

Priority services registration not completed
Account UT-6640. A priority services register application for a customer dependent on powered medical equipment was submitted three weeks ago; the stated turnaround is ten working days. The application is incomplete without a contact number for a nominee. The agent can complete it immediately.
I applied for the priority services register on account UT-6640 three weeks ago and heard nothing. Your website says ten working days.
My husband uses an oxygen concentrator, so a power cut is not a minor inconvenience for us. Winter is coming and I am anxious about it.
Complete the registration today if you can. Tell me what is missing and I will give it to you right now on this call.

Smart meter display stopped updating
Account UT-2214. The in-home display has shown no usage for eleven days; the meter itself is transmitting normally and the display has lost its radio pairing. The agent can send a replacement display and can confirm that billing is unaffected.
The smart meter display on account UT-2214 has shown nothing for eleven days. The screen is on but the usage figure never changes at all.
I use it to keep a close eye on what we spend each day, especially since the children came home for the summer.
Tell me whether my bills are affected by any of this, and then get the display working properly again for us at home.

Meter readings not submitting online
Account UT-7730. Online reading submission rejects the entry because the meter serial on the account does not match the physical meter, which was exchanged eight months ago. The agent can update the serial and accept the reading directly.
Your website will not accept my meter reading for account UT-7730. It says the reading is invalid every time I enter it.
The number I am entering is 08412, read left to right off the front of the meter. My meter was swapped for a new one earlier this year.
Take the reading from me now and fix whatever is wrong at your end so I can do it myself next time.

Low water pressure since a network repair
Account UT-9928. Pressure at the property has been low since a mains repair in the street sixteen days ago. Minimum service pressure is defined in the standards. The agent can book a pressure test and can apply a guaranteed standards payment if the test fails.
The water pressure at my property on account UT-9928 has been poor since you repaired the mains in our street sixteen days ago.
The shower barely runs upstairs and the boiler cuts out if anyone uses a tap elsewhere. Two neighbours in the street say the same thing.
Send someone to test it, and tell me what happens if the pressure is below what you are meant to supply to us.

Prepayment meter not accepting top-ups
Account UT-3345 on a prepayment electricity meter. Three top-ups totalling 60.00 were bought but the codes are rejected; the meter is on an out-of-date firmware key set. The agent can issue replacement codes and can apply emergency credit remotely.
My prepayment meter on account UT-3345 will not take any of the three top-up codes I bought. It shows an error after each one.
I have receipts for sixty pounds in total from the shop on the corner. The meter is down to its emergency credit now.
Get power onto the meter today, please. Tell me what to do with the three codes I have already paid for at the shop.

Gas boiler service under a care plan not booked
Account UT-5512 with a boiler care plan including an annual service. The online booking tool returns no availability because the plan record shows the service as already completed, which it was not. The agent can correct the record and book the visit.
I cannot book the annual boiler service included in my care plan on account UT-5512. Your booking page shows no appointments at all for months.
The plan renewed in March and no engineer has been here since. Your system apparently thinks the service has already happened this year.
Correct that and book me a visit this month. I would like a morning appointment if any of those are still available.

Repeated short power interruptions
Account UT-8871. The property has experienced eleven brief interruptions in ten days, each under a minute. Network logs show a recurring fault on the local feeder under investigation. The agent can register the address on the fault, can request an investigation visit, and cannot give a repair date.
The power at my property on account UT-8871 has cut out eleven times in ten days. Each one only lasts seconds, but it is constant.
It has already damaged a freezer full of food and my home office equipment keeps restarting. I work from home four days a week.
Tell me what is causing it and when it will stop. I also want to know how to claim for the damage.

Cancelling a fixed tariff before the end date
Account UT-2204 on a fixed tariff ending in seven months with an exit fee of 60.00 per fuel. Exit fees do not apply in the final 49 days. The agent can quote the fees and can schedule the switch for the fee-free window.
I want to leave the fixed tariff on account UT-2204. There are seven months left on it and I have been offered a better rate elsewhere.
I believe there are exit fees of sixty pounds per fuel, and I have both gas and electricity with you, so that would be a hundred and twenty.
Tell me the exact cost of leaving now, and whether waiting is cheaper. I will decide once I have both numbers in front of me.

Refund of a credit balance while the account stays open
Account UT-6619 holds a credit balance of 340.00 built up over the winter. Policy permits refunding credit above the amount needed for the next two months, about 190.00, on an up-to-date reading. The agent can refund the surplus.
My account UT-6619 has built up three hundred and forty pounds in credit over the winter. I am not closing the account, I just want it back.
I gave a reading last week so the balance should be accurate. My direct debit has not changed at all this year.
Refund what you can today and tell me exactly how much of it you are keeping back and the reason for that.

Cancelling a boiler care plan mid-term
Account UT-4490 on an annual boiler care plan of 288.00 paid monthly, four months in, with one repair visit already used at a list value of 190.00. Cancellation terms allow cancellation with the used-service value deducted. The agent can cancel and calculate the balance.
I want to cancel the boiler care plan on account UT-4490. I am moving to a flat with a communal heating system in six weeks.
I have had one repair visit under the plan, back in June, when the pressure kept dropping. Otherwise I have not used it.
Tell me what cancelling costs me given that visit. I will decide whether to cancel now or run it to the move.

Compensation for a missed engineer appointment
Account UT-7702. An engineer did not attend a booked morning appointment and no notice was given. A guaranteed standards payment of 30.00 applies per missed appointment. The agent can apply the payment and rebook.
Nobody came to the morning appointment booked on account UT-7702. I waited from eight until one and then called you myself in the end.
I arranged cover at work for it and no one contacted me at any point during the morning to say it was not happening.
Apply whatever compensation is due and rebook me for another day. I want the payment confirmed today, not just the new appointment.

Closing an account after moving out
Account UT-1180. The customer moved out eighteen days ago and gave no closing reading; the account continues to bill on estimates. The new occupant has provided a move-in reading. The agent can close the account on that reading and issue a final bill.
I moved out of the property on account UT-1180 eighteen days ago and the account is still billing me. I gave you my forwarding address.
I did not take a reading on the day, unfortunately. The new tenant moved in the following morning and may well have taken one.
Close the account from my move-out date and send me a final bill. Use the new tenant's reading if that is possible.

Refund after a duplicated payment
Account UT-3372. A monthly direct debit of 118.00 was collected and the customer also paid 118.00 by card on the same day. The account is 118.00 in credit. The agent can refund the card payment within five working days.
I have paid twice on account UT-3372 this month. The direct debit took a hundred and eighteen pounds and I also paid the same by card.
I paid by card because I thought the direct debit had failed after seeing a message in your app. It clearly had not failed.
Refund the card payment rather than leaving it as credit. Tell me exactly when it will be back in my bank account.

Cannot register for the online account
Account UT-5540. Online registration fails because the account is held in joint names and the registration form matches only the first-named holder. The customer is the second-named holder. The agent can register them after verification.
I cannot register for an online account for UT-5540. The form rejects my details even though I am copying them from the bill.
The account is in both my name and my wife's, and hers is printed first. I pay the bills and deal with everything else on it.
Register me so I can see the account online. Tell me exactly what you need from me to verify who I am.

Account in a deceased relative's name
Account UT-8890 held in the name of the customer's late mother. Transfer requires a death certificate or a bereavement notification reference. The agent can place the account in bereavement handling, suspend collections and transfer once documents arrive.
The account UT-8890 is in my mother's name. She died last month and I am dealing with the property and all of her affairs.
She lived alone and the house is empty now, though the heating is on low so the pipes do not freeze over the winter.
Tell me exactly what you need from me, and stop any letters chasing payment while all of this is being sorted out.

Landlord and tenant both billed for one supply
Property supply UT-2291 has two open accounts, one in the landlord's name and one in the tenant's, for overlapping periods. The tenancy agreement determines liability from 1 March. The agent can close the landlord account from that date.
Both my landlord and I are receiving bills for the same supply at UT-2291. He has forwarded me his and they overlap with mine.
My tenancy started on the first of March and I opened my account that week. His account appears to have stayed open throughout.
Sort out which account is live from March and close the other one. Neither of us wants to pay twice for the same supply.

Adding a partner as an authorised contact
Account UT-6605 in the customer's sole name. Adding an authorised contact requires the account holder's consent, which the caller can give, and identification of the nominee. The agent can add the contact with defined permissions.
I want to add my partner to account UT-6605 so he can call you about it. The account is in my name only.
I travel for work for weeks at a time and he deals with anything that happens at the house while I am away.
Add him as someone you will talk to. Tell me exactly what he will and will not be able to do on the account.

Meter serial on the bill does not match the property
Account UT-4433. The meter serial on the bill belongs to a neighbouring property; usage patterns suggest the two supplies were crossed at registration. The agent can raise a supply verification and cannot rebill until it completes.
The meter serial number printed on my bill for account UT-4433 does not match the meter in my cupboard. The numbers are completely different.
My neighbour mentioned her bills look unusually low, and mine have looked far too high since we both moved in two years ago.
Check whether our supplies have been crossed. Tell me what happens to the bills either of us has already paid over those years.

Tariff change blocked by an outstanding balance
Account UT-7051 carries an arrears balance of 280.00, which blocks a tariff change under the credit rules. A payment plan clearing the arrears within twelve months restores eligibility. The agent can set up the plan and apply the tariff on its first payment.
I am trying to move to your cheaper fixed tariff on account UT-7051 and the website will not let me. It gives no reason at all.
I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have been paying off a bit at a time when I can.
Tell me whether the balance is the reason and what I must do to qualify. I want the cheaper rate as soon as possible.
